title: Spotify (SPOT) Up 16% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
author: Na
description: Spotify reported Q2 2026 earnings with 300 million premium subscribers and 777 million MAUs, beating guidance on user metrics. However, EPS missed consensus estimates, and subsequent estimate revisions have trended downward by 12.06%. The stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating despite strong growth fundamentals, suggesting in-line returns ahead.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While Spotify demonstrated strong user growth (300M premium subscribers, 777M MAUs) and margin expansion, the company missed EPS estimates by 7.3%, and consensus estimates have declined 12.06% post-earnings. The Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and weak Momentum Score (F) indicate limited upside despite positive fundamentals, suggesting a neutral outlook.

Palantir reported exceptional Q2 2026 results with 92.8% YoY revenue growth and EPS of $0.41 (up from $0.16 YoY). Consensus estimates have increased 8.7% over the past month, and the company received a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating, indicating strong positive momentum and growth expectations.

title: Why Figma Stock Climbed 13% in August
author: Jeremy Bowman
description: Figma stock rose 13% in August despite an initial post-earnings sell-off, driven by a broad software sector recovery and strong earnings reports from peers like Salesforce. The company reported its third consecutive quarter of accelerating revenue growth (48% increase) and beat earnings estimates, though investors remain concerned about rising costs and margin compression from AI feature development.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 earnings with 48% revenue growth (third consecutive quarter of acceleration), beat on revenue ($370.1M vs $351.5M consensus) and EPS ($0.08 vs $0.04 estimate), raised full-year guidance to 39% growth. Stock climbed 13% in August despite initial sell-off.
Delivered strong earnings report on Aug. 27 that lifted the entire software sector, demonstrating the sector can continue to grow in the AI era and boosting investor confidence in software stocks.
Surged on earnings report on Aug. 4, which caused Figma to jump in sympathy, indicating strong performance in the software/tech sector.
Mentioned as a competitor that Figma is challenging for leadership in design software, but no specific sentiment drivers provided in the article.

title: Why Is Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Up 10.6% Since Last Earnings Report?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Palantir Technologies delivered exceptional Q2 2026 results, beating earnings estimates with $1.94B in revenue (92.8% YoY growth) and $0.41 EPS (156.3% YoY growth). The company's commercial business surged 109.7% YoY, driven by strong AI platform adoption. Management raised full-year guidance significantly, projecting $8.15-8.158B in revenue and $4.5-4.7B in adjusted free cash flow. The stock has gained 10.6% since the earnings report and received a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 earnings beat with 92.8% YoY revenue growth and 156.3% YoY EPS growth. Commercial revenue surged 109.7% YoY. Management raised full-year guidance by ~$500M. Exceptional margins (86% gross, 62% operating), strong cash generation ($1.22B free cash flow), record bookings of $3.4B, and 157% net dollar retention demonstrate robust business momentum and customer expansion. Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating reflects analyst confidence.

Modest 6.8% YoY revenue growth and 17.1% YoY EPS growth in last reported quarter. Stock gained only 4.8% over the past month, significantly underperforming PLTR. Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) indicates neutral outlook with no estimate revisions in the last 30 days. VGM Score of D suggests limited appeal across investment strategies.

title: Insider Waves Goodbye to More Than 48,000 Shares of Defense Stock Worth $4.8 Million
author: Jake Lerch
description: Mercury Systems CEO William L. Ballhaus sold 48,812 shares worth $4.8 million in a non-discretionary tax withholding transaction. The CEO retains 236,666 total shares valued at $22.3 million. While the company shows strong revenue growth and backlog, concerns include margin compression, valuation stretched at 5.0x price-to-sales ratio, and inflation pressures from legacy fixed-price contracts.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed fundamentals with positive revenue growth ($984M, up from $835M in 2024) and strong backlog supported by military spending and Palantir partnership, offset by margin compression (operating margin down to 2.1% from 9.8% in 2021), stretched valuation (5.0x P/S vs. 5-year average of 3.3x), and inflation concerns from fixed-price contracts. The insider sale is non-discretionary and not indicative of negative sentiment.
Mentioned as a new partnership with Mercury Systems that is boosting the company's backlog amid increased military spending, indicating positive business momentum.
